failure_evidence.cause: Nested remote-shell quoting split the intended one-string prompt passed through --prompt into whitespace-delimited prompt items.
failure_evidence.operator_action: Sent SIGTERM only to the smoke process PID 2858115 after confirming the protocol violation; no external process was modified.
failure_evidence.interpretation: The run proves official checkpoint loading and initial generation pipeline execution, but is invalid as the preregistered one-prompt smoke. Partial media must not be benchmarked or used as a result.
failure_evidence.corrective_action: Use a one-line prompt file with --prompt-path in a fresh run directory, avoiding shell splitting.
